decisions.reason: As a homepage-featured product close to the firm’s traditional handcrafted décor range, it reflects visible commitment and a natural extension of existing capabilities, so management is unlikely to withdraw it quickly.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid fits the core product line very closely and was promoted on the home page, making it an easy product for management to justify and continue.

Although the electronic music box is more distant from the firm’s craft-based tradition, it was launched prominently on the home page, so sunk effort and public commitment make continued support more likely than an early withdrawal.
This motif platform is a more peripheral, distant add-on that was only mentioned on the website, so the firm has less visible commitment to defend and can discontinue it more easily.
Like product D, this Christmas motif platform is a less central accessory in a non-core electronic line with limited public commitment, making removal within the year relatively likely.
The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm’s established strengths and was highlighted on the home page, so management would be inclined to keep it on the market.
